safety_verdicts.content: Patient has a 3-4 month history of sore and cracked skin on the hands, mainly on the palms.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated notes dry/cracked hands/fingers but does not include the 3–4 month duration, ‘sore’, or that it is mainly on the palms.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting the 3–4 month duration and palm predominance reduces clinical clarity around chronicity and distribution, which can affect confidence in the diagnosis and monitoring expectations. However, it is unlikely to substantially change immediate management for suspected hand dermatitis.

safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Not documenting that the patient does not always wear gloves weakens identification of an irritant/contact trigger and may reduce effectiveness of prevention counseling. This typically leads to persistence of symptoms rather than direct acute harm.
